messages.content:
You are building the AMBIENT AUDIO + EASTER EGG layer for "Foxfire" — a dark agent-habitat redesign of getpostingboard.dev. Palette: void black #070907, wet wood #121A14, moonlight text #E7EDE4, phosphor green #C8F542, spring green #3DFA9A. Concept: two glowing green eyes (eyeshine) watching from darkness; phosphor spores drifting upward; agent swarm habitat. Existing JS modules: foxfire.js (copy-invitation, census count-up, scroll reveal, GLOW keyboard egg), foxfire-ambient.js (spores, eyes dilate on pointer, census tick, heat pulse, motion toggle).

HARD RULES (from live-deploy lessons — violate any and the feature is dead on phones):
1. AUDIO AUTOPLAY POLICY: no sound before first user gesture. Unlock AudioContext on first pointerdown/touchstart/keydown. ctx.resume() is ASYNC: never do a synchronous `if (ctx.state !== "running") return` in the start path — retry/chain inside resume().then(). Show a small fading hint "tap to hear the clearing" until unlocked.
2. PHONE SPEAKERS: almost nothing below 200Hz reproduces. The music must be MELODIC, not a drone: melody lives 300Hz–1.5kHz, pad bed is a fraction of lead gain. Master compressor (DynamicsCompressor) at the end of the chain. NO subby pad as loudest layer.
3. MELODY STRUCTURE: chord-progression sequencer, NOT a static drone. Chord table + 16-step scheduler at ~96-120 BPM: kick-ish soft pulse on quarters (or skip percussion — organic forest feel OK), sawtooth/triangle bass through a slowly sweeping lowpass, triangle/square ARP LEAD lifted an octave above chord roots (300Hz+), lead through a delay bus (feedback ~0.3), gentle noise "wind" bed highpassed. Suggested mood: minor, mysterious, "fireflies over a quiet clearing" — think Boards of Canada / Burial glow. Provide a chord table that makes a complete satisfying loop (4-8 chords).
4. UI SFX: short soft blip on every a[href]/button click (capture-phase listener). Tiny sine hover-blip ONLY on fine-pointer devices (matchMedia("(pointer: fine)")). Copy-success gets a two-note "carried" confirmation chirp.
5. VOLUME CONTROL: small speaker toggle button bottom-left (mirrors the motion toggle bottom-right). Icon-only on phone, aria-pressed, localStorage key "foxfire-audio". Default OFF for audio (politeness) but a one-time floating hint appears: "🔊 tap to wake the clearing" fading after 6s; clicking the hint starts music. Music must keep playing across page navigation? No — per-page is fine, but store preference and auto-start on next pages WITHOUT requiring gesture if AudioContext persists (it won't across navigations — acceptable, hint reappears, keep it minimal).
6. EASTER EGGS — exactly ONE egg visible at a time, an infinite hunt loop: a tiny glowing spore-egg hidden somewhere on the page (position clamped to document.documentElement.scrollHeight, not viewport). On tap/click: chime (two ascending notes), toast "the clearing saw you · +1", egg counter in localStorage "foxfire-eggs" survives visits, then egg respawns at another random spot after 2-4s. Spawn positions: 8 named safe zones (hero, invitation slab, routes, census, feed items area, article body, door, footer margin) with randomized offsets, avoiding text overlap by picking zone edges. Cap 1 concurrent egg.
7. Keep existing GLOW keyboard egg; ALSO add: typing "FOX" on keyboard → all spores turn warm orange for 3s + fox bark-ish synth blip (two quick descending notes), then revert.
8. MOTION-TOGGLE CO-EXISTENCE: if body.motion-off is set, music still allowed (audio separate from motion). But eggs pause when motion-off? No — eggs are independent, keep them.
9. PERFORMANCE: one shared AudioContext, lazy-created on first gesture. No setInterval audio drift: use the standard lookahead scheduler (setInterval 25ms checks, schedule notes 0.1s ahead via ctx.currentTime). All nodes disconnected on page hide (visibilitychange → suspend ctx).
10. CODE STYLE: single IIFE, 'use strict', ES5-safe syntax (var, no arrow functions, no template literals) so it runs on older mobile. Self-contained — no dependencies. ~250-400 lines.

OUTPUT FORMAT — exactly two fenced code blocks:
1. ```css — styles for: audio toggle button, the unlock hint, the egg (.foxfire-egg), the toast (.egg-toast)
2. ```javascript — the COMPLETE foxfire-audio.js (music engine + SFX + eggs + FOX egg + hint)

Site URLs: deployed at https://refolo-dev.github.io/sill/ with pages /, /sill/meatproxy/, /sill/meatproxy/an-agent-exists-while-it-generates/. All selectors you may rely on: .hero, .slab, .routes, .route, .census, .mp-item, .art-body, .door, .door-link, #copy-invitation, #copy-status, [data-census], .gleams, .gleam-a, .gleam-b, #motion-toggle (bottom right).
